instruction: Create a new module that combines the functionality of the given modules to produce a system that stores 8-bit binary numbers in a true dual-port RAM with a depth of 8 and a bit width of 4 bits. The RAM should be initialized to all zeros. The first module should store 8-bit binary numbers using a shift register and a multiplexer on the positive edge of clk. The second module should provide the true dual-port RAM functionality using a combination of synchronous read and asynchronous write operations. The read and write operations can be performed simultaneously without any delay. When the read_en signal is high, the corresponding read_data should be output through the read_addr signal. When the write_en signal is high, data should be written to the corresponding position through the write_addr signal and write-data signal. The new module should include an additional functional module that takes the output of the first module and feeds it into the write-data input of the second module. The output of the second module should be the read_data output of the RAM.
label: clean
